For a small commercial building in Indore, I’d prioritize serviceability + pressure consistency, not just HP.

Option	Typical price	Best for	When premium is justified
CRI 1–1.5 HP booster	₹24k–38k	Daily commercial use	Good middle ground; worth it for multiple floors/steady usage. 
Moglix

Kirloskar CPBS 1–1.5 HP	₹28k–35k	Offices/shops	Best overall if downtime matters; strong Indian service ecosystem. 
Kirloskar E-shop

Grundfos ~0.9–1 HP	~₹46k+	Premium installations	Justified for quieter operation, higher reliability and heavy daily usage.

My pick: Kirloskar CPBS. Spend extra over a basic ₹8k–15k pump if the building has 3+ floors, frequent simultaneous taps, or rental/commercial tenants. Otherwise, premium hardware may not pay back.
